aenigma, aenigmatis n.

noun, third declension

riddle, puzzle

The Vatican lexicon uses it for a quiz. Neither source has a word for a jigsaw.

Examples

  • Aenigma tibi prōpōnam: quid est?

    I’ll give you a riddle: what is it?composed

See also playing card, game board.

SourcesLewis & Short: aenigma

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 367.
